events.factual_description: Kenichi Tsunoda Big Band's official schedule lists a Saturday, October 24, 2026 celebration of jazz bar Volontaire's 50th anniversary at COTTON CLUB in Marunouchi, running from 17:00 to 20:00. The program combines the Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Trio — Yamamoto, Hiroshi Kagawa and Chikko Soma — with tenor saxophonist Seiichi Nakamura, vocalist Sari and the Kenichi Tsunoda Big Band. The source states that tickets are sold out.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a routine Yamamoto club date. It folds his trio into the 50th-anniversary celebration of Volontaire, a long-running Tokyo jazz bar, alongside veteran tenor saxophonist Seiichi Nakamura, Sari and Kenichi Tsunoda's full big band. The value is the living ecosystem around the music: club history, veteran players and a large-ensemble celebration converging for one night.
en.trip_verdict: S+ under the current Yamamoto/Kanto rule and culturally worth crossing Tokyo for if access appears. But the official source says it is sold out, so do not build travel around admission unless a legitimate opening emerges.

es.why_it_matters: No es otra fecha rutinaria de Yamamoto en un club. Su trío entra en la celebración de los 50 años de Volontaire, un bar de jazz de larga historia en Tokio, junto al veterano tenor Seiichi Nakamura, Sari y la big band completa de Kenichi Tsunoda. Lo importante es el ecosistema vivo alrededor de la música: historia de club, músicos veteranos y una celebración de gran formato que convergen una sola noche.
es.trip_verdict: S+ bajo la regla actual de Yamamoto/Kanto y culturalmente vale cruzar Tokio si aparece acceso legítimo. Pero la fuente oficial indica que está agotado, así que no conviene construir el viaje alrededor de la entrada salvo que se abra una oportunidad real.
